definition: The task of determining which words or phrases in a text refer to the same underlying entity, such as linking a pronoun back to the noun it refers to.
details: Coreference resolution is important for tasks requiring a coherent understanding of a document as a whole, such as summarization or question answering over long texts with many pronouns and repeated references.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Here is the short version: The task of determining which words or phrases in a text refer to the same underlying entity, such as linking a pronoun back to the noun it refers to. The part that makes it sing: Coreference resolution is important for tasks requiring a coherent understanding of a document as a whole, such as summarization or question answering over long texts with many pronouns and repeated references. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Coreference Resolution — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
